name: Nomad Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum gross annual income of EUR42,000 for applications submitted on or after 1 April 2024 (EUR32,400 grandfathered for applications submitted before that date).
requirements.fix_path: Increase documented qualifying income to at least EUR42,000/year.

requirements.blocker_text: Must either work for an employer registered abroad under a contract of work, conduct business as a partner/shareholder in a foreign-registered company, or provide freelance/consulting services to clients whose permanent establishments are abroad. Persons contracted by a foreign company specifically to serve a Maltese subsidiary are ineligible.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying remote employment, shareholding, or freelance contracts
Health insurance covering the EU (incl. Malta) and UK
Property rental or purchase agreement in Malta

outcome.duration_length: typically issued for 1 year, renewable (exact maximum renewal period not confirmed at tier-1 in this pass)

sources.title: Residency Malta Agency -- Nomad Residence Permit eligibility: EUR42,000 income threshold (EUR32,400 grandfathered), eligible remote-work categories, health insurance, accommodation, police conduct

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 (Residency Malta Agency's dedicated Nomad Residence Permit subdomain). work_rights set to 'restricted': the permit only authorises the specific qualifying foreign remote-work arrangement, not local Maltese employment. family_can_join set false and leads_to_pr / leads_to_citizenship set false as a conservative inference consistent with this permit's non-settlement design (tier-3 sources describe dependants as includable and describe a flat 10% tax rate, but neither was independently confirmed at tier-1 in this pass, so they are not modelled here). Applicants should verify current family-inclusion and renewal-cap rules directly with Residency Malta Agency before relying on this route for a multi-year stay.
